Situated only steps away from the Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre, the 4-star hotel features an Indonesian restaurant serving American cuisine. This Hanoi hotel has a prime setting merely 1.6 km from Vietnam Military History Museum, while natural sights like the shaded park "Hanoi Botanical Garden" are 2.3 km away. In proximity to the Old Quarter Hotel & Travel Hanoi, business travellers will find the turtle Thap Rua Tower. Guests might as well enjoy proximity to Hang Trong Garden, situated nearly 5 minutes away by car. The nearby sports attractions feature the multi - purpose Hang Day Stadium 2.4 km from the property. Hanoi Old Quarter Hotel & Travel is not far from Ha Noi train station. All of the allergy-free rooms are appointed with a flat-screen TV with satellite channels along with a minibar fridge, and some of them include a balcony and a seating area. For your comfort, you will find an electric kettle and glassware. The private bathrooms with a bidet, a walk-in shower, and a separate toilet also offer hairdryers and shower caps. Guests can enjoy views of the lake from the Old Quarter Hotel & Travel. Begin the day with continental breakfast.
